Scale.summary: Ruler control: draws horizontal tick lines with min/0/+max labels. Inherits from Control.

props.logBase: Logarithmic scale base; default 1.5. The current drawing code does not use this field
props.noFont: When true the numeric labels are not drawn; default false
props.fontsize: Font size in pixels (8), also used as the tick line height
props.scaleFunction: Optional non-linear mapping function (0-1 to 0-1) that maps tick values to horizontal positions; nil means even spacing
props.color: Tick line and label color; default {0,0,0,1} black

Scale:DrawControl.desc: Draws the horizontal axis and tick lines (centered on 0 and mapped non-linearly when scaleFunction is set) and prints the min, 0 and +max labels.

Scale:HitTest.desc: Always returns false; the ruler is not interactive.

fileDesc: Ruler control: draws horizontal tick lines and numeric labels, either linear or non-linear via a custom scaleFunction.
